summary: Full-stack engineer building AI systems in healthcare end-to-end — LLM agents, RAG/retrieval, prompt and output-guardrail design, and evaluation, plus the React/TypeScript UIs and Python/Node APIs around them. Shipped an LLM clinical decision-support agent and an AI pediatric health product used by parents, and built Refill Arena from zero to $1M+ revenue across 3,200+ brands in 190+ countries. Strong across React, Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL/NoSQL, async workflows and AWS, with a bias for ownership from design through iteration.

bullets: Built an AI pediatric health platform end-to-end — React/Next.js UIs and Node.js APIs on PostgreSQL, with video/sound-based check flows and a triage chatbot.
Owned features from ambiguous requirements to release, working US hours with clinicians and a remote team.
Built an LLM clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and diagnostic guidance.
Designed retrieval, prompt and output-guardrail layers for a production medical chatbot, with evaluation and monitoring.
Built the data layer with Node.js, PostgreSQL and Redis; improved data-access performance by **30%**.
Built a healthcare/wellness app with React/Next.js and NestJS APIs on PostgreSQL, using LangChain and RAG pipelines over third-party health data.
Built a token-streaming LLM renderer in React (**98%** rendering accuracy) and an AI trainer feature that raised engagement **40%**.
Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system applying LLM extraction to automate clinical workflows.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue** — React front end, relational schema, scalable REST APIs and high-throughput ingestion across **3,200+ brands** / **190+ countries**.
Modelled data for access patterns; kept services at **99.9% uptime** with automation and monitoring.
Improved backend performance **25%** via query optimisation and caching; built JWT auth and Stripe payments.
Delivered features independently from requirements through deployment.
